notes: The cord at Kalyani's neck is kept as the source image and not expanded into a ritual explanation.
translation.english_text: Kalyani! Kalyani! My Kalyani is poor. She has no good sari—only one sari, a patched cloth... She has no diamond necklace; there would only be a cord around her neck... Ayyo, not even that. She is a widow.

notes: The verified source form `மூணுக்கொதிப்பு` is pressure-sensitive and remains exposed as `moonukkothippu` rather than silently repaired.
translation.english_text: Don't be afraid. If we give `moonukkothippu` medicine, he will be all right.

Medicine! Ha, ha! Medicine for me? I don't want it. If there is some medicine that can keep the poor from feeling hunger, give that, doctor. Won't you give it? Won't you? After that they will throw children into the river, doctor—they will throw them into the river. My Kalyani did just that. Kalyani! Kalyani!
